description.value:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.spells.Item.SpllGnNarakumiJt]{Magen: Narakumi no Jutsu}.

You see your worst fear made real. You take 2d6 persistent mental damage and are frightened 2. On every turn while you have persistent mental damage from this effect, you must succeed a flat DC 15 Will save or be fleeing for that turn.
